working_revision: PR59 (R12; original PR48 experimental baseline plus eleven revisions)
requirements: Replace new ordinary ghost recording with automatic streamed MSGT and preserve Save/Discard, names, library, splits, PB ownership and race/watch workflows.
Full-world on-board replay is required; Mario-only drawing is insufficient. Initial world state and replay fidelity must be proved.
Recording, playback and racing share one bounded MEM2 arena. Concurrent recording/racing lease different live chunks in that common arena.
Allocate an additional 1.5 MiB to game loading/cache only after the legacy payload owners have migrated.
Benchmark an additional 500 KiB for savestate saving on the user Wii. Retain only if it saves at least two game frames; otherwise allocate it to loading/cache.
measurement: Sirena 4 baseline in pr12-sirena4-baseline.json. Only same-Wii comparisons establish loading/savestate speed; Dolphin tests establish correctness.

compatibility.moonshine_version: Informational; not a rejection key. Compatible future releases must read earlier recordings.
compatibility.format: Versioned schemas and required capabilities; unknown optional records can be skipped. Changes to required semantics need explicit migration/rejection.
compatibility.racing: Recorded motion/animation does not interact with the live world. Preserve cross-region visual racing.
compatibility.full_world: Final user decision 2026-10-30: full-world playback requires the same Sunshine region (JP to JP, US to US, PAL to PAL). This supersedes the proposed cross-region disclaimer policy. Visual racing remains cross-region. Moonshine release number alone must never invalidate an otherwise compatible recording.
compatibility.native_checkpoints: Optional native snapshots need explicit layout compatibility and cannot be the sole portable representation. Never restore file-supplied pointers without owner/range validation.
compatibility.known_differences_source: User report 2026-10-30; not yet independently audited in regional binaries.

known_differences.us_pal: Hover does not extinguish them immediately.

known_differences.jp: Fruit storage and instant remount unavailable.
known_differences.us_pal: Fruit storage and instant remount possible.

known_differences.difference: US/PAL has additional fruit not present on JP; starting actor roster differs.
A Yoshi clip works only on JP.

compatibility.timing_difference: User reports PAL fadeouts two game frames shorter than US at 60 Hz. Suspected 50 Hz origin is unverified. This affects transitions even when gameplay physics match.
compatibility.legacy: Preserve existing .smsghost Watch and racing with their original visual playback, sharing the arena. Missing historical world data cannot be recovered; do not advertise legacy files as full-world replays.
compatibility.watch_two: Preserve Watch 2, split alignment and scrubbing as visual comparison, using the shared arena. Full-world playback drives one recorded world at a time.

memory: pr11-memory-estimate.json is a planning estimate, not already-free memory. It predates the full-world replay requirement and must be revalidated. Preserve all three savestate slots and unrelated legacy bank tails.
additional_observation: User reports a pause after the IL menu closes, predating MSGT and seeming longer recently. Native departure uses a 0.4-second wipe with movement stopped. Additional I/O delay is not yet measured.
